name: D2 ticket → implement (qwen-local) → notify
description: One Diablo-2 TICKETS.md ticket implemented by local Qwen3.8-27B (free, single-slot, ~88 tok/s — small tickets). TWO nodes, no verify step (Kevin 2026-08-18): the seat implements, the orchestrator (kimi-2) reviews the diff on notify and drives the next ticket. Params: ticket (e.g. T001), agent (notify target, e.g. kimi-2). NOTE like exec-notify: a failed delegation is a RESULT (ok:false), not a node failure — the notify fires either way and states exit/ok rather than declaring success.
